column1: # Nine Commits, post 2 — every run behind the table in index.mdx.
# 42 runs of one question against gpt-5-mini at commit v2-hands:
#   "Which file in this project sets the model name the agent uses, and what is it set to?"
# The only variable is TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS. Everything else is held fixed.
# TRANSCRIBED BY HAND from each run's stderr line and the outcome the recorder
# derived for it. It is a weaker artifact than a machine-written log — the rows
# were read off a terminal by a person — and this file says so rather than
# letting you find out. From v2 the CLI appends its own row to
# agent/traces/runs.tsv, so the next post's tally is generated, not typed.
# Rows are in BOOKKEEPING ORDER, not run order. The two runs published as
# traces are last, at rows 41 and 42; they were chronologically first. The
# blocks above them are, in order: 5 precise, 5 thin, 15 precise, 15 thin.
# tools_called is what the model actually called, comma separated: one run
# (row 23) called both in a single step, which prepareStep does not prevent
# because it caps steps rather than calls within a step.
# outcome is derived by agent/src/recorder.ts against
# success = the final answer carried both facts, partial = one, failure = none.
